description: The record of a company's AI governance decisions: layers, owners, controls, enforcement points, evidence and the regulatory map, each tied to a finding, policy or law in the briefing.
The implementable part of the decision: one entry per layer plus inventory, identity, data, model, cost, oversight and regulatory settings precise enough to check.
The team that audits a control is not the team that operates it, so the evidence is credible.
Human review sized so reviewers can disagree, with measured override rates and an appeal path for affected people.
The record that shows a control ran: decision logs, eval records, cost reports, review minutes.
